title: Study of Brexucabtagene Autoleucel Plus Dasatinib in Adults With Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia

sections.abstract: To assess the feasibility of oral dasatinib pulses (3 consecutive days per week) during the first month following infusion of brexucabtagene autoleucel (Tecartus) in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
